CustomField.description: Depending on your Revenue Management settings for the Project object, you can add the following fields to the Project Reporting dataset in your PS Cloud Core Analytics app: Project Cost Amortized, Project Revenue Recognized, Project Total Cost Amortized, and Project Total Revenue Recognized.
